# möbius CLI 0.15.51

Updates the bundled gateway to 0.15.52 with browser-viewing availability, capability-owned transcript links, and runtime activity and idle-shutdown controls. Shared account persistence and endpoint selection now belong to the gateway crate; account storage and terminal behavior are preserved.

Pins mobius 0.15.48 and mobius-gateway 0.15.52. Protocol 85 and CLI configuration are unchanged. Packages retain LICENSE and NOTICE.
